demo.title: Parcel on its way

demo.title: Parcel is delayed

demo.title: Return approved

demo.title: Return window ended

demo.title: Ask for a photo

demo.title: Replacement sent

demo.title: Wrong item apology

demo.title: Size and material

demo.title: Gift question

demo.title: Payment failed
demo.answer: Your payment did not go through. Please try another card or use the payment link in this message.

demo.title: Charged twice
demo.answer: We found two charges and have asked the payment provider to refund one. It takes a few working days.

demo.title: Cancelled before shipping
demo.answer: Your order is cancelled and the refund is on its way to the original payment method.

demo.title: Too late to cancel
demo.answer: Your order has already shipped. You can return it when it arrives and we refund it.

demo.title: Address changed
demo.answer: We changed the delivery address as you asked and the parcel has not shipped yet.

demo.title: Parcel already shipped
demo.answer: The parcel has shipped. We asked the carrier to change the address and will confirm.

demo.title: Code does not work
demo.answer: Please check the minimum order and the end date of the code. We can apply the discount by hand.

demo.title: Code after the order

demo.title: Quote sent

demo.title: Minimum order

demo.title: Back in stock date

demo.title: Alternative product

guide: Open Start and type your shop name and your own limits in the yellow cells: the return rate you accept, the days for a quick refund, the label cost, the handling cost and your rating goals.
Fill Products with your catalogue (SKU, cost, web price, supplier) and Suppliers and Team with the people your messages go to.
Record each return on Returns: date, order, customer, SKU, reason, status, refund and restock decision. The refund check and the net cost fill in by themselves.
Write the refund of each paid return on Refunds, the inspection on Restock Decisions and the claims for faulty units on Supplier Claims.
Log parcels that arrived damaged on Damaged in Transit with the carrier, the packaging and a photo flag, so the carrier claim is not forgotten.
Use Return Rate by Product and Return Rate by Channel to see where returns come from and which product can bear its rate; add the causes and fixes on Return Reasons.
Keep the service queue on Tickets, the standard answers and response targets on Topics and Macros and the weekly cover on Service Roster.
Record reviews on Reviews and reply to low-star ones; see disputes on Disputes and win-back vouchers on Win-back Vouchers.
Track products with a quality problem on Quality Issues and fill Service Log by Month once a month.
Use the 14 calculators for the cost of a return, break-even, refunds, restock value, supplier claims, response times, staffing, ratings, goodwill and vouchers.
Print 10 sheets and 10 letters, follow 10 checklists and tap a message link to open a chat with the text ready.
Read Returns and Service Dashboard and Charts every week: refunds waiting, tickets over target, return rate, cost of returns and reviews to answer.

listing.title: Online Seller Returns and Customer Service Excel Template: Returns, Refunds, Tickets, Reviews, Restock, Supplier Claims, Dashboard
listing.headline: See what every return costs and keep customer service on target
listing.description:
Run the returns and the customer service of your online shop from one Excel workbook. Returns holds every return request from the request to the refund, with the reason, the status, the restock decision, the days to refund and the net cost of the return: the label, the handling and the stock you lose. A refund check flags refunds that are due or overdue against the quick refund limit you set.

Return Rate by Product shows units sold and returned, the check against your limits, the loss on one return and the return rate at which the margin of each product is gone. Return Rate by Channel and Service Log by Month put returns, tickets per 100 orders, response times, satisfaction and reviews side by side for every month, and Return Reasons lists two typical causes and fixes for each of the eight reasons.

Refunds, Restock Decisions and Supplier Claims follow the money: what was paid back, the value recovered when items are resold as new or as seconds, and the credit still to claim from a supplier. Damaged in Transit keeps the carrier claims, Tickets checks every ticket against the response target of its topic, Reviews flags low-star reviews without a reply, and Quality Issues, Disputes and Win-back Vouchers close the loop.

14 calculators cover the cost of a return, break-even, refunds with tax, restock value, supplier claims, response times, staffing, star ratings, satisfaction, goodwill and vouchers. Print 10 sheets and 10 letters, follow 10 checklists and send 28 messages that open with the details already written in.

This is part five of the Online Seller suite. A standard .xlsx workbook with no macros and no subscription, 15 languages in one purchase, with a demo copy full of sample data for a small shop with about 40 orders a day. It helps you organise your work and does not promise results.

signature.name: Return reasons with causes and fixes
signature.why: two typical causes for each of the eight return reasons, the fix, its owner and due date, and the returns each cause explains

signature.name: Return rate by product with break-even
signature.why: each product's return rate is checked against your limits and against the rate at which its margin is gone after label, handling and stock lost

signature.name: Net cost of every return
signature.why: the return label, the handling and the stock lost on a write-off, a second or a supplier credit are added up for each return

signature.name: Refund clock with overdue check
signature.why: days from the request to the refund, a check against your quick refund limit and a flag for refunds that are due or overdue

signature.name: Restock decisions with value recovered
signature.why: every returned unit gets a grade and a decision, and the value recovered and the value lost are worked out from the landed cost

signature.name: Supplier claims for faulty returns
signature.why: faulty units sent back are turned into claims with the goods value, the days open, the credit received and the amount not credited

signature.name: Damaged in transit and carrier claims
signature.why: each parcel that arrived damaged is logged with the carrier, the packaging and a photo flag so that the claim is made in time

signature.name: Ticket queue with response targets per topic
signature.why: every ticket is checked against the response hours of its topic, with days open and the customer's rating

signature.name: Return and service trend by month
signature.why: returns, return rate, tickets per 100 orders, response hours, satisfaction and reviews side by side for every month

signature.name: Review reply tracker
signature.why: low-star reviews without a reply are flagged, each review is assigned to an agent and the average stars of every product is kept

signature.name: Product quality issue register
signature.why: products with a quality problem get an action, an owner, a due date and the return rate that shows whether the fix works

signature.name: Win-back vouchers with margin won
signature.why: the vouchers sent after a bad experience are tracked until used and the margin won after the voucher cost is worked out

competitors.lacks: lists returns but never works out the cost of a return, the break-even return rate of a product or the value recovered when items are resold
answers tickets but does not link them to returns, refunds, supplier claims and product quality, and it charges every month
creates labels and refunds but gives no restock grading, no supplier claims and no view of which products you should stop selling
one sheet of tickets with no response targets per topic, no review replies, no disputes and no win-back vouchers
calculates one refund but keeps no record, no refund clock and no monthly return rate to act on

messages.text: Hello {customer}, your return {return_id} for {product} is approved. Your return label is attached. Please pack the item in its original box and hand the parcel to the carrier.
Hello {customer}, we received your return {return_id} ({product}). We are checking the item and will pay your refund of {refund_amount} soon.
Hello {customer}, your refund of {refund_amount} for return {return_id} was sent on {refund_date}. It can take a few days to show in your account.
Hello {customer}, we are very sorry that {product} from order {order_id} arrived damaged. A replacement ships today and you do not need to send the damaged item back.
Hello {customer}, we are sorry about {product} in order {order_id}. Please send a photo of the item and of the box so that we can fix this today.

messages.moment: Customer: the return window has ended
messages.text: Hello {customer}, we are sorry, the return window for order {order_id} has ended, so we cannot approve return {return_id}. We would like to offer a voucher for your next order instead.

messages.moment: Customer: wrong item, new one coming
messages.text: Hello {customer}, we sent the wrong item in order {order_id}. The correct {product} is on its way and a label for the wrong item is attached. We are sorry.

messages.moment: Customer: we are looking into it
messages.text: Hello {customer}, we are looking into your ticket {ticket_id} about {topic}. We will write again within {target_hours} hours.
Hello {customer}, your ticket {ticket_id} is resolved. Did our answer help? Please reply with a number from 1 to 5, where 5 is very helpful.

messages.moment: Customer: thank you for your review
messages.text: Hello {customer}, thank you for your review of {product}. It helps other customers and our small team a lot.

messages.moment: Customer: voucher for your next order
messages.text: Hello {customer}, we are sorry about your last experience. Here is a voucher of {voucher} for your next order, valid for 45 days.
Hello {customer}, we issue a credit note for the damaged goods in return {return_id} ({product}, {qty} units). The credit of {refund_amount} is applied to your account.
Hello {customer}, please fill in the damage form for order {order_id} and send it with photos of the boxes or the pallet. We need it before we can claim from the carrier.
Hello {name}, please check the tickets that are over their response target today and answer the oldest ones first.

messages.moment: Lead: reason trend on a product
messages.text: Hello {owner}, the returns of {product} show a trend: {issue}. {units_returned} units came back, a return rate of {return_rate}. Please look at the pattern this week.

messages.moment: Lead: new macro for a topic
messages.text: Hello {owner}, please review the standard answer {title} for the topic {topic}. Check the tone and the facts before we add it to the list.
Hello {agent}, please answer review {review_id} for {product} today. Customer: {customer}. The review says: {comment}.

messages.moment: Warehouse lead: returns to inspect today
messages.text: Hello {name}, please inspect the returns that arrived today and enter a restock decision for each one.
Hello {checked_by}, {product} came back damaged again (return {return_id}, packed in: {packaging}). Please check the packing before the next parcel goes out.

messages.moment: Warehouse: restock units of a product
messages.text: Hello {inspected_by}, please put {units} units of {product} back on the shelf ({decision}, {grade}) and update the stock count.
Hello {owner}, the return rate of {product} is {rate}. The main reason is {top_reason}. Please look at the listing, the packing and the supplier.
Hello {handled_by}, claim {claim_id} for {supplier} is ready: {units} units of {product}, worth {amount}. Please send it today.
Hello {name}, the weekly returns report is ready. Please read the return rate by product and the open supplier claims before our meeting.
Hello, {units} units of {product} were returned as faulty. Please send a credit note for {amount}. Our claim is {claim_id} and our return is {return_id}.
Hello, customers report a quality problem with {product}: {issue}. {units_returned} units have come back so far. Please tell us the cause and how you will fix it.
Hello, the parcel for order {order_id} arrived damaged ({product}). We have photos and ask you to open a claim for {value}. Our reference is {return_id}.
Hello {name}, the returns cost for this month is ready on the dashboard. Please look at the cost of returns and at the products above the return limit.
Hello {owner}, the listing of {product} may cause returns: {issue}. Please check the photos, the size and the description this week.

documents.title: Return authorisation and label note
paragraphs: Return authorisation of {set:shop}, dated {today}.
Return {col:returns.return_id} for order {col:returns.order_id}, requested on {col:returns.date}. Customer: {col:returns.customer}.
Item: {col:returns.product}, quantity {col:returns.qty}. Reason given: {col:returns.reason}.

Your return is approved. Please pack the item in its original box with the paper note, stick the return label on the parcel and hand it to the carrier. The label cost is {col:returns.return_ship_cost}.
When the parcel arrives we inspect the item. The refund of {col:returns.refund_amount} is paid back to you after the check. Please keep your proof of posting until the refund is paid.
documents.note: Sample wording: adapt it to your country's law and your own practice.

documents.title: Refund confirmation to the customer
paragraphs: Refund confirmation of {set:shop}, dated {today}.
Refund {col:refunds.refund_id} for order {col:refunds.order_id}. Customer: {col:refunds.customer}.
We paid back {col:refunds.amount} on {col:refunds.date} by {col:refunds.method}. The amount holds {col:refunds.items} for the items and {col:refunds.tax} of sales tax.
The refund is {col:refunds.share} of the order total of {col:refunds.order_total}. It can take a few working days to show in your account.
Thank you for your patience. If anything looks wrong, please write to us and quote the refund number.
documents.note: Sample wording: adapt it to your country's law and your own practice.

documents.title: Return summary report for a month
paragraphs: Return summary report of {set:shop}, dated {today}.
Month starting {col:bymonth.month}. The shop shipped {col:bymonth.orders} orders and {col:bymonth.units_sold} units.
Customers sent back {col:bymonth.units_returned} units in {col:bymonth.returns} returns, a return rate of {col:bymonth.return_rate}. Our accepted rate is {set:return_limit}.
Refunds paid were {col:bymonth.refund_value}. The cost of returns, with labels, handling and stock lost, was {col:bymonth.return_cost}.

Customer service answered {col:bymonth.tickets} tickets, {col:bymonth.tickets_100} for every 100 orders. The first answer took {col:bymonth.avg_first_hours} hours on average and {col:bymonth.over_target} tickets were over target.
The average satisfaction score was {col:bymonth.csat} out of 5 and the average review was {col:bymonth.avg_stars} stars.
documents.note: Sample wording: adapt it to your country's law and your own practice.

documents.title: Supplier claim letter for returned units
paragraphs: Claim letter of {set:shop}, dated {today}.
To {col:claims.supplier}. Claim {col:claims.claim_id}, return {col:claims.return_id}.
Our customers returned {col:claims.units} units of {col:claims.product} ({col:claims.sku}) as faulty. The goods value of these units is {col:claims.amount}.
Please send a credit note for this amount or replace the units. We have photos and the inspection notes and can send them on request.
Please confirm the claim and the credit within {set:claim_days} days. We also ask you to tell us what caused the fault and what you will change.
documents.note: Sample wording: adapt it to your country's law and your own practice.

documents.title: Product quality report
paragraphs: Product quality report of {set:shop}, dated {today}.
Product: {col:quality.product}. Supplier: {col:quality.supplier}. Issue {col:quality.issue_id}, first seen on {col:quality.first_seen}.
Problem: {col:quality.issue}. Main return reason: {col:quality.reason}. {col:quality.units_returned} units came back, a return rate of {col:quality.return_rate}.
Action: {col:quality.action}. Owner: {col:quality.owner}. Due on {col:quality.due}. The action check shows: {col:quality.state}.
We review this issue every month until the return rate is back under {set:return_limit}.
documents.note: Sample wording: adapt it to your country's law and your own practice.

documents.title: Customer service weekly report
paragraphs: Customer service weekly report of {set:shop}, dated {today}.
Week starting {col:roster.week}. Team member: {col:roster.person}. Shift: {col:roster.shift}.
Hours worked: {col:roster.hours}. Tickets handled: {col:roster.tickets_handled}, which is {col:roster.per_hour} tickets for every hour and {col:roster.week_share} of the tickets of the week.
Our targets: first answer within the hours set for each topic, a ticket resolved within {set:resolve_days} days and a satisfaction score of {set:csat_goal} out of 5.
Please add your notes on repeated questions and on products that cause tickets.
documents.note: Sample wording: adapt it to your country's law and your own practice.

documents.title: Review summary report for a product
paragraphs: Review summary report of {set:shop}, dated {today}.
Product: {col:rbp.product}. Category: {col:rbp.category}.
The product has {col:rbp.review_count} reviews with an average of {col:rbp.avg_stars} stars. Our goal is {set:rating_goal} stars.
Of {col:rbp.units_sold} units sold, {col:rbp.units_returned} came back, a return rate of {col:rbp.rate}. The main reason is {col:rbp.top_reason}. The rate check shows: {col:rbp.flag}.
The product can bear a return rate of {col:rbp.breakeven} before its margin is gone. We use this report to decide on listing changes, packing changes and supplier talks.
documents.note: Sample wording: adapt it to your country's law and your own practice.

documents.title: Dispute evidence letter
paragraphs: Dispute evidence of {set:shop}, dated {today}.
Dispute {col:disputes.dispute_id} for order {col:disputes.order_id}, amount {col:disputes.amount}, opened on {col:disputes.date}. Reason given: {col:disputes.reason}.
We ask you to review the order of {col:disputes.customer}. We hold the order confirmation, the proof of delivery and the messages with the customer, and attach them to this letter.
The goods were packed and handed to the carrier as described in the order. We believe the charge is correct and ask you to close the dispute in our favour.
Evidence is due on {col:disputes.due}. Please confirm that you received this letter.
documents.note: Sample wording: adapt it to your country's law and your own practice.

documents.title: Return policy page text
paragraphs: Return policy of {set:shop}.
This policy covers {col:policy.category} bought on {col:policy.channel}.
You can return an item within {col:policy.window_days} days of delivery. The item must be in this condition: {col:policy.condition}.
The return label is paid by: {col:policy.label_paid}. We refund the price of the item and the sales tax after we have checked the parcel. We aim to pay within {set:refund_days} days of your request.
Write to us before you send anything back and we send you the label and the steps.
documents.note: Sample wording: adapt it to your country's law and your own practice.

documents.title: Apology and voucher letter
paragraphs: Letter of {set:shop}, dated {today}.
Dear {col:followups.customer},
We are sorry about your last experience with us. We want to make it right and offer you a voucher of {col:followups.voucher} for your next order.
The voucher is valid for 45 days from {col:followups.sent_on}. Please show it at checkout or tell us when you order.
Thank you for giving us another chance. We will take extra care with your next parcel.
documents.note: Sample wording: adapt it to your country's law and your own practice.
